title: [i18n] The two hand-rolled provider-less fallback interpolators still use String.replace — a gantt task titled `A$&B` renders `{{title}}` back into the delete dialog
body:
Found while implementing #3865 (`createSafeTranslation`'s fallback). **Out of scope there** — #3865 touches only `packages/i18n/src/useSafeTranslation.ts`, and neither file below goes through it. Filed unassigned.

## Mechanism

objectui#3418 fixed the shared helper's fallback interpolator: `String.prototype.replace` was replaced with `split(needle).join(value)` because `replace`/`replaceAll` interpret `$&`, `` $` ``, `$'` and `$$` **in the replacement string**, and i18next does not. That comment is still in `useSafeTranslation.ts` today and names the reachable half: *"Values here are runtime data — record labels, search terms — so this one is reachable today."*

Two hand-rolled copies of that interpolator were never converted. Both are deliberate non-users of `createSafeTranslation` (each says so in a comment, with a valid per-key-fallback reason), so the shared fix never reached them:

1. `packages/plugin-gantt/src/useGanttTranslation.ts:116`

   ```ts
   v = v.replace(`{{${k}}}`, String(val));
   ```

   Carries **both** harms: first occurrence only, and `$`-pattern interpretation.

2. `packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx:204`

   ```ts
   out = out.replace(new RegExp(`{{${k}}}`, 'g'), String(v));
   ```

   The `g` flag covers the repeated-placeholder harm; the `$`-pattern harm remains, because it lives in the replacement string, not the needle. (The needle is also an unescaped `RegExp` — inert today since all placeholder names are bare identifiers.)

## Reachability — measured, not argued

`gantt.delete.body` is `'"{{title}}" will be permanently removed. This action cannot be undone.'` and its call site is `packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx:1570`:

```ts
t('gantt.delete.body', { title: pendingDelete.title })
```

`pendingDelete.title` is a **record title** — user data. Measured on `origin/main` @ `d2e2caf40` (node, the exact expression above):

| task title | rendered today | correct (`split`/`join`) |
|---|---|---|
| `A$&B` | `"A{{title}}B" will be permanently removed.` | `"A$&B" will be permanently removed.` |
| ``x$`y`` | `"x"y" will be permanently removed.` | ``"x$`y" will be permanently removed.`` |
| `p$$q` | `"p$q" will be permanently removed.` | `"p$$q" will be permanently removed.` |

The first row is the ugly one: `$&` expands to the matched text, so the **placeholder itself** is printed back to the user inside the record's own name.

This is the provider-less path only (standalone embedding / tests). With an `I18nProvider` mounted, i18next serves these keys and is literal on both sides.

## Scope of a fix

Mechanical: use the same `split(needle).join(String(v))` the shared helper uses, in both files, plus a test per file with a `$&`-carrying value. No pack, key or call-site change. The three `{{count}}` gantt keys are unaffected (numbers), and `gantt.quickFilter.resultSummary`'s deliberate single-brace idiom (pinned by `gantt-quickfilter-locale-parity.test.ts`) is not touched.

The larger question — whether these two hand-rolled fallbacks should exist at all, given the per-key fallback reason each cites — is separate; #3865's option C (retiring the defaults tables) is the thread where that belongs.

Related: #3418 (the shared-helper fix these two copies missed), #4157 (the other gantt interpolation defect, at the call site rather than the interpolator), #3865 (where this was found), #3512 (a third defect of the same shared fallback).
